translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Wochchiyaa adussa gimbbiyaa bolla kesa ek'k'aade taani naagana. He sa'aan S'oossay taana giyaabaanne ta maganaw I immiyaa zaaruwaa sisanaw s'eellashshana.
Med'ina Goday Imbbaak'oomawImmeedda Laa"entso Zaaruwaa
Med'ina Goday taw zaariide, «Wos's'iyaa uraykka nabbabana mala, masetteedda shuchchaa bolla taani new k'onc'c'issiyaa sas'aa ordduwaan s'aafa.

Ayaw gooppe, sas'aan beetteeddawe bare keeretteedda wodiyaa naagee. He sas'ay polettiyaa wodii ellekka gakkanawaa; wordduwaa gidiide de'enna. Takkiyaabaa malatinttokka naaga; ayaw gooppe, I tumuwaappe yaana; gam"enna.
«Be'a, I otoretteedda; Aa k'ofa ubbaykka suure gidenna; shin s'illuu bare ammanuwaan de'ana.»
Nagaranchchatuwaa Bollaa Aad'd'eedda Pirddaa

Duretetsay asaa c'immee; otoranchcha asaw shemppo baawa. I duufuwaadan yora gidiyaa dirawunne hayk'k'uwaadan kalli erenna asaa gidiyaa diraw, kawutetsatuwaa ubbaa barew shiishshee; asaa ubbaakka barew omoodee.

«Asay barentta omoodeeddawantta, ‹Barewaa gidenna miishshaa shiishshiide dagayiyaawoonne ac'uwaa asaappe wolk'k'an akkeedda mas'uwaan durettiyaawoo aayyero! Hawe hawaadan haniidde, awude gakkanaw de'anee?› yaagi k'iliic'ananne toochchana.
Neeni unttunttoo tal"eedda asatuu ne akeekenan ne bolla denddiide, neena kokkorssana. Hewaappe guyyiyaan, unttunttu ne mas'uwaa ubbaa bonk'k'anawantta.

Neeni c'ora yaraa mas'uwaa bonk'k'eedda diraw, unttunttuppe atteeddawanttu ne mas'uwaa bonk'k'anawantta. Ayaw gooppe, ne daro asaa suutsaa gussaadda; k'ay sa'aa ubbaan, katamatuwaa bollanne unttunttun asaa bollakka sugetsaa oosuwaa ootsaadda.
«Metuu neena gakkennaadan, ne golliyaa d'ok'k'asaan kees's'anaw naak'uwaan miishshaa shiishshiyaawoo, new aayyero!
Daro asaa ne genaade d'ayisseeddawaa gaasuwaan ne soo asaa kawushshaadda; neeni ne bolla bayetsaa ahaada.
Haray atto ne golliyaa gimbbiyaa shuchchaykka ne bolla waassana; tuusatuukka waasuwaa allanawantta.
«Katamaa makkalan baasiide, asaa suutsan kees's'iyaawanttoo, hinttew aayye ana!
Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'ina Goday Asay ootsiyaawe ubbay tamaa kaate gidanaadan, k'ay kawutetsatuu ubbay daaburiyaawe c'oo mela gidanaadan, k'ofaa k'achchi wotseedda.
Ayaw gooppe, haatsay abbaa kammiyaawaadan, Med'ina Godaa bonchchuwaa eratetsay sa'aa kumana.
«Bare shooro Asay kallottina be'ana giide, iitabaa gujaaninne unttuntta ushshiide matsoyiyaa uraw aayye ana!
Neeni bonchchuwaa diraw kawushshaa mayyana. Ha"i simmi laa neenoo, usha! Ushaade ganddigaara! Med'ina Godaw ushechcha kushiyan de'iyaa s'uu'ay neekko yaana; ne bonchchuu kawushshaw laamettana.

Neeni Liibaanoosa d'ayisseeddawaadan, neenikka d'ayana. Neeni do'atuwaa wora wurssaadda; ha"i k'ay unttunttu neena yashissana. Ayaw gooppe, ne daro asaa suutsaa gussaadda; k'ay sa'aa ubbaan, katamatuwaa bollanne unttunttun de'iyaa asaa bollakka sugetsaa oosuwaa ootsaadda.

«I barew eek'ay ayaa maaddii? Aa Asay giigisseedda gidennee? Wordduwaappe attina, aan harabay ayaynne beettena. Yaatina, Aa med'd'eedda bitanii ha ayinne haasayenna eek'aa ammaniyaawe Aa ayaa maaddanaassee?

Mitsaappe masetteeddawaa ‹Beegotta!› giyaawoo, k'ay shuchchaappe masetteedda duudiyaa, ‹Dendda ek'k'a!› giyaawoo, new aayye ana! I won new ayentto k'onc'c'issanaw danddayii? Be'a, I work'k'aaninne biran sheeshsheeddawaa; aw shemppuu baawa.
«Shin Med'ina Goday bare geeshsha Geeshsha Golliyaana. Hewaa diraw, biittan sa'aan de'iyaa Asay ubbay Aa sintsan c'o"u go» yaageedda.
